name: Any Hour Services / Any Hour Group
subject: How Any Hour Services / Any Hour Group tracks trade licences by state
text:
Hello,

I saw your 25 locations in 10 states, which is why I am writing to you
rather than to a list.

I am building StateReady: it keeps one record of every contractor
licence, qualifying individual and renewal date you hold, per state, and
tells you which one is about to lapse before a permit desk does.

With your 25 locations in 10 states, the same question repeats at every
branch.

Straight with you: StateReady is new, I have no customer results to
quote, and I am not going to quote any.

What would help me is fifteen minutes on how you handle it today: where
the licence list lives, who watches the renewal dates, and what happens
when an acquisition arrives with its own. If that is not worth your
time, a no closes it and I will not chase.

--
StateReady, a TheVillage company
TheVillage - [PHYSICAL ADDRESS PLACEHOLDER - set OUTBOUND_POSTAL_ADDRESS]
Reply to this message, or write to [SENDER ADDRESS PLACEHOLDER - set OUTBOUND_FROM_ADDRESS], and I will remove your
organisation from my list permanently.
